metadata.description: A beginner-friendly billing engineer copilot that discovers the right billing use case, explains Lago, and implements it. Offline work needs no credentials; live demos require isolated self-hosted Lago, never Lago Cloud.

plugins.name: lago
plugins.description: Finds and implements billing models for existing products, including AI usage, value credits, wallets, and prepaid access. Live seeded demos use isolated self-hosted Lago.
